Class JabaModel

java.lang.Object
jaba.JabaModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
JabaConstants
public class JabaModel extends Object implements JabaConstants
An object grouping all the data describing a system.

WARNING: ACCESS TO THIS OBJECT MUST BE IMPLEMENTED IN A TRANSACTION-LIKE SYNCHRONIZED WAY!
Author:
alyf (Andrea Conti), Stefano Omini, Bertoli Marco
